facts.rubric: Located SCH-4410 using immutable identifiers and preserved effective policy revision v4: the stranded loads are SCH-4410..SCH-4413; the first affected is SCH-4410 (certified revenue load for MDL-REV-D).
facts.statement: DATA-0006: the stranded loads are SCH-4410..SCH-4413; the first affected is SCH-4410 (certified revenue load for MDL-REV-D); the effective policy revision is v4.

facts.rubric: Applied the controlling evidence and the effective policy to establish 8 WINDOW_HOUR for window hours for four displaced 120-minute certified loads, with control date 2026-03-17.
facts.statement: The controlling evidence and effective policy establish window hours for four displaced 120-minute certified loads = 8 WINDOW_HOUR: four 120-minute loads need 8 window-hours, or 2 free windows when two loads share a window. The control date is 2026-03-17 (the earliest displaced pair (cycle 2026-03-10) hits its 5-business-day deferral limit on 2026-03-17).

facts.rubric: Reconciled 32 observed less 28 excluded to 4 supported WINDOW_HOUR for window hours on WH-STD between 2026-03-10 and 2026-03-13.
facts.statement: WH-STD offers 32 window-hours in gross across 2026-03-10..2026-03-13; 28 are reserved or protected, leaving one free window (4 h) on 2026-03-11, 4 hours short; eligibility requires netting the exclusions rather than trusting a header total.

facts.rubric: Used the independently confirmed 2026-03-16 expedited readiness input for wait_for_xl_return, then separately derived its 2026-03-23 operating outcome under free regular windows on the working cluster without displacing the replication window instead of treating a vendor promise as authorization or a completion date.
facts.statement: Harrier's confirmed re-cut dates for the next snapshot cycle on HR-8830: Harrier HR-8830 confirms the next snapshot re-cut standard 2026-03-18 and expedited 2026-03-13 (+USD 195); it constrains next week's cycle, not this re-windowing; a vendor confirmation alone proves neither validation nor load.

facts.rubric: Applied free WH-STD windows, two certified loads per window to derive the three option outcomes without using protected or blocked windows.
facts.statement: free WH-STD windows, two certified loads per window: the free WH-STD windows are 2026-03-11 day and 2026-03-16 night; WH-XL returns 2026-03-19 with its first free window 2026-03-23; protected and blocked windows cannot be displaced.

facts.rubric: Applied AP-DD-0206 only to rewindow_loads_to_open_windows and SCH-4410; kept displace_replication_window outside current authority.
facts.statement: AP-DD-0206 authorizes free regular WH-STD windows with two loads per window; the replication window needs Femi and WH-ADHOC is prohibited. The approval does not select an option in advance and does not authorize displace_replication_window.

facts.rubric: Compared all three alternatives and selected rewindow_loads_to_open_windows: it is the best currently authorized response that satisfies free regular windows on the working cluster without displacing the replication window.
facts.statement: the earliest pair must certify by 2026-03-17 and the last by 2026-03-19, or the marts decertify; a faster or broader action has value only if it remains inside free regular windows on the working cluster without displacing the replication window.

options.consequence: rewindow loads to open windows pairs two 120-minute loads in WH-STD's free day window on 2026-03-11 and the other two in its free night window on 2026-03-16, so the last certified load lands 2026-03-16, inside every deferral limit, at no incremental cost.
options.label: rewindow_loads_to_open_windows: outcome 2026-03-16, incremental cost USD 0, SUPPORTED_AND_APPROVED

options.consequence: wait for xl return holds all four loads for WH-XL's first free window on 2026-03-23; it costs nothing but runs every load past its 5-business-day deferral limit and decertifies the marts.
options.label: wait_for_xl_return: outcome 2026-03-23, incremental cost USD 0, FEASIBLE_WITH_INFERIOR_TRADEOFF

options.consequence: displace replication window would finish all four loads by 2026-03-12 using WH-STD's protected replication window and adds about USD 450 of replication catch-up egress, but displacing a protected window needs Femi Oyelaran, which AP-DD-0206 explicitly withholds.
options.label: displace_replication_window: outcome 2026-03-12, incremental cost USD 450, SEPARATE_APPROVAL_OR_POLICY_EXCEPTION_REQUIRED

instruction: Platform ops pulled cluster XL this morning for a storage firmware patch that runs through next Thursday, stranding the four certified finance loads that live in its night window. None of them may run more than five business days past its cycle date or the mart is decertified. Figure out how much window time the loads need, what is honestly open on the standard cluster without touching replication, and how far into next week the last one lands. Re-window the first stranded load where it fits and leave warehouse ops a note covering the rest and anything needing Femi.
